description: Independent evidence for automation claims. Registry labels in technique-foundation-map.js and enemy adapters are declarations, not certification.

claims: Blade, Pole and Chain expose only their canonical Skirmish conditions.
Equip is stored as an authoritative scene rule mode with one receipt per mode and Turn.
Canonical Strengthen, Launch and Shred consequences are emitted through typed post operations.

tests.case: Armament conditions, receipts, typed post effects, stale source and replay-safe dispatch
Blade/Pole/Chain resolution, once-per-Turn gates, KO cancellation and canonical effects
LionWing identity, page 79 provenance and full canonical level digests

edgeCases: Repeated Equip of the same mode in one Turn is rejected.
A stale source digest cannot commit an Armament Finisher path.
Direct browser/network and saved-scene surface evidence remains manual.

claims: The second Equip in the current Turn grants exactly 1 AP.
The same second Equip applies Hasten through the normal effect lifecycle.
First and third Equip events do not grant duplicate Like Water rewards.

tests.case: Second and third Armament Equip AP/Hasten boundaries and next-Turn reset
Mode receipt gate and canonical Multi-Faceted contract
Canonical Like Water text and digest

edgeCases: A second Armament of a different mode is the only rewarded second Equip.
A third Armament in the same Turn leaves the reward count at one.
UI, network races and persisted browser reload are not independently evidenced.

claims: Only a Talent Finisher can consume the currently equipped Armament bonus.
Blade uses a bounded legal path, Pole uses a two-cell line and verified Spike state, and Chain derives its square from an adjacent center and actual Criticals.
Reducer validation rechecks source digest, geometry and derived target ids before mutation.

tests.case: Blade/ Pole/ Chain geometry, target derivation, forged cells, stale source, Spike terrain and diagonal path rejection
Canonical Master At Work text, page 79 source and digest
Master Armament lifecycle and typed effects used by the shared finisher pipeline

edgeCases: A successful Pole Spike creates Difficult Terrain even with zero Criticals.
A diagonal or otherwise forged Blade path is rejected before target mutation.
Live browser selection, network concurrency, persisted reload and direct PDF page render remain manual.
